title: Alabama National Guard Aviation Assists With Wildfire Suppression
description: U.S. Army flight crews with the 1-131st Aviation and 1-169th Aviation provide firefighting support to help suppress wildfires affecting the Alexandria, LA region, Aug. 31- Sept. 5, 2023.  Alabama aviators, along with other neighboring states, successfully assisted with clearing more than 231 miles of linear fire breaks in Louisiana.  (U.S. Army video by Spc. Carlos Parra)
keywords: alabama national guard, Wildfire, fire suppression, Chinook, blackhawk, Louisiana, Alabama
